title: Trajectory-Regularized Distribution Distillation for One-Step Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.12978v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distilling flow matching models for one-step generation generally follows two paradigms. Trajectory alignment supervises the student with the teacher's probability flow ODE, but its performance degrades under very small sampling budgets. Distribution matching directly optimizes the generated distribution, but estimating its reverse Kullback-Leibler gradient typically requires a separate network to track the evolving student score. We propose trajectory-regularized distribution distillation (TRD), which combines distribution-level and trajectory-level supervision through a momentum-mixture policy predicted in a single student forward pass. This policy serves simultaneously as a one-step generator, an estimator of the student's marginal velocity that removes the need for a second trainable network in distribution matching, and a closed-form time-dependent velocity field supervised along the teacher ODE trajectory. Experiments on SANA-1.6

translated_title: 面向一步式生成的轨迹正则化分布蒸馏
translated_abstract: 将流匹配模型蒸馏用于一步式生成通常遵循两种范式。轨迹对齐方法利用教师的概率流ODE对学生模型进行监督，但在极小的采样预算下其性能会下降。分布匹配方法直接优化生成分布，但估计其反向Kullback-Leibler梯度通常需要一个额外的网络来跟踪学生模型不断演变的分数。我们提出轨迹正则化分布蒸馏（TRD），通过在单次学生前向传播中预测的动量混合策略，将分布级与轨迹级监督结合起来。该策略同时充当一步式生成器、学生边际速度的估计器（从而免除分布匹配中对第二个可训练网络的需求），以及沿教师ODE轨迹进行监督的闭式时变速度场。在SANA-1.6上的实验……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 提出轨迹正则化分布蒸馏（TRD），通过单次前向传播预测的动量混合策略统一分布级与轨迹级监督，无需额外可训练网络即可实现高质量的一步式生成。
en_tdlr: Proposes trajectory-regularized distribution distillation (TRD), which unifies distribution-level and trajectory-level supervision through a momentum-mixture policy predicted in a single student forward pass, eliminating the need for a separate trainable network while enabling high-quality one-step generation.
